name: fuellink
description: FuelLink — Nigeria's downstream energy exchange & intelligence layer. Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js), apps/api (NestJS, Phase 2), packages/contracts (shared schemas).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fuellink/web && npm run build --workspace @fuellink/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @fuellink/web && npm run lint --workspace @fuellink/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fuellink/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @fuellink/api
